description: A Coordination-Free Parallel Framework for High Time Resolution Unit Commitment Problems is a data set deposited in Figshare by its authors Weijun Cai. A Coordination-Free Parallel Framework for High Time Resolution Unit Commitment Problems input data, including the modified Polish 2736-bus system、dispatchable units data、one year actual load and wind data with 5-min time resolution and 10-min resolution. Coverage: national (PL); the metadata date the deposit to 2025. The formats are not stated in the metadata. Size stated: 57718653 Bytes. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-figshare-repository.
